messages.message: Hi, mera bill bahut zyada aaya hai and my phone is not working properly. Bahut frustration ho raha hai!
Hello! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I am Meera. How can I help you today?
Mera bill wrong hai, please check karo. Also, my device is lagginggingging
I need your account number to check the details. Please provide it.
My account number is 50937131. My name is Karan Johnson, phone 97750 30454, and DOB is 26/01/1981.
Account verified. I see a charge for a premium service you did not activate. I will raise a refund request for this wrong charge.
Thank you, but please jaldi karo. I need the money back soon.
The refund is subject to approval and will take 7-10 business days to reflect in your account.
Theek hai. And what about my phone? Screen freeze ho raha hai constantly.
I will book a device check for you at our nearest center. Please confirm your address: 230 Station Road.
Yes, that is correct. Address sahi hai. Thank you so much Meera, you helped me a lot! 😊
Is there anything else I can help you with? I have raised the refund request and booked your device check. Goodbye!
